mapper.insert: INSERT INTO figure_type_group (user_id, name, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE figure_type_group SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_group_id = #{figureTypeGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure_type_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_group_id = #{figureTypeGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.figure_type_id FROM figure_type c JOIN figure_type_group p ON p.figure_type_group_id = c.figure_type_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
